# Sourdough

Sourdough is leavened by a culture of wild yeast and lactic acid bacteria ([[Bread book (source)]]). The baker keeps the culture as a starter and builds a [[Levain]] from it for each bake ([[Bread book (source)]]). A long, cool fermentation gives the crumb its open structure ([[Bread book (source)]]).
